name: group_by_with_disambiguated_columns
description: A :grouped query whose parent and child columns collide is reported, not split into an empty parent struct once the names are disambiguated
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE orders (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), total NUMERIC);
query_sql:
-- @name GetUsersWithOrderIds
-- @returns :grouped
-- @group_by users.id
SELECT u.id, o.id
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;

error.message_contains: matched none of the query's result columns
